Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered job.if (no trigger of the pipeline has a Woodpecker event; the workflow never runs)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
